Meta: _econur_positioning: Everyday antibacterial protection for skin that faces dust, sweat and city air.
Meta: _econur_benefits:
Deep pore cleansing
Fights acne-causing bacteria
Soothes irritation
Non-stripping moisture balance
Meta: _econur_efficacy:
Neem purifies :: Neem leaf extract carries natural antibacterial compounds that calm breakouts and keep pores clear.
Tulsi calms :: Holy basil reduces redness and irritation after a long day of dust and sweat exposure.
Coconut oil conditions :: Cold-pressed coconut oil rebuilds the skin barrier so cleansing never leaves skin tight.
Meta: _econur_ingredients:
Neem Leaf Extract
Tulsi (Holy Basil)
Cold-Pressed Coconut Oil
Shea Butter
Vitamin E
Meta: _econur_best_for:
Oily and acne-prone skin
People who work outdoors
Daily body and face cleansing
Humid weather
Meta: _econur_usage:
Lather with warm water and massage onto damp skin for 30 seconds, then rinse well. Use morning and night.

Store on a draining soap dish away from direct water spray - a dry bar lasts noticeably longer.
